card.name: Verbs reporting adverse events occurred
card.fires_on: The verb right after an adverse event noun in warnings, such as 'occurred', 'occur', 'reported' or 'have'. It also fires on the noun ending 'malignancies' or on 'events' before 'have been reported'.

modes.label: Occurred after malignancy
modes.description: The verb 'occurred' following a serious event noun, before 'in patients treated with' a drug.
modes.example: ( 5.2 ) Malignancies have<< occurred>> in patients treated with LEQSELVI

modes.label: Occur or reported in trials
modes.description: Verbs like 'occur' or 'reported' stating that a serious event or overdose happened.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE Three cases of overdose were<< reported>> in controlled clinical trials with Dalfam

modes.label: Event noun or auxiliary
modes.description: The end of an event noun or the auxiliary 'has' or 'have' just before 'been reported' or 'occurred'.
modes.example: Herpes zoster<< has>> occurred in subjects receiving NUCALA
